# Exstrade 2.0 Terminal Instructions

## Setup Status

- [x] Modernized Exstrade 2.0 dual Forex and Deriv Synthetic Trading Terminal.
- [x] Responsive 3D glassmorphic UI with vibrant neon cyber aesthetics.
- [x] Real-time orderbook, interactive candlestick charts, RSI/MA indicators, and Deriv option mechanics (Under/Over, Even/Odd, Higher/Lower, Rise/Fall).
- [x] Binance-style 3D biometric face verification scan & WebAuthn hardware passkey enrollment.
- [x] Allocation Tiers starting at $50 (Satoshi) up to $100,000+ (Genesis).
- [x] Side Admin Operations Portal with customer management, account suspension/unsuspension, and deposit approval queue.
- [x] Clean build and 0 lint warnings.

## Development

- Follow existing React 19, TypeScript, Vite, and Lucide conventions.
- On Windows PowerShell, use `npm.cmd` for install, build, lint, and dev commands.
- Validate changes with `npm.cmd run build` and `npm.cmd run lint`.
